name: Tiwanaku

categories.label: Group score (shared marker, after final offering)
categories.labelVi: Điểm nhóm (marker chung, sau lễ vật cuối)
categories.hint: Shared score track of the group, including the final offering.

categories.label: Otoma people score
categories.hint: Otoma score marker, after their final offering and 1 VP for each empty gameboard space.

categories.label: Group won (more VP than Otoma)
categories.hint: Strictly more VP than the Otoma; a tie goes to the Otoma.

winCondition: Cooperative: the game ends when nobody has a Terrain tile behind their screen at end of a turn; the group and the Otoma make a final offering and the Otoma score 1 VP per empty gameboard space. The group wins only with strictly more VP than the Otoma (a tie is an Otoma win). Solo: same comparison against the Otoma, with no final divination round after all tiles are placed.

endCondition.description: Cooperative: no Terrain tiles left behind any screen at end of a turn

notes: family: coop-vs-automa. Solo mode (long scenarios only, 45 spaces) uses the same win test: you win with more VP than the Otoma, ties go to the Otoma. Coop needs the long scenario and 2-4 players (4 players form 2 pairs). Difficulty modes (easy/normal/expert) change Otoma meeple count only.
